en: Color-tinted historic postcard showing a large two-story brick building with a tower topped by a cross-shaped mast and a flat roof terrace. The structure has many tall windows and a modest garden or yard with small trees in front. The sky is softly shaded in pastel tones. Text in Russian, German/Latin script, and Estonian is printed at the top describing the place as a maritime school in Baltiski (Baltic Port).
